provider_terminal.final_payload_summary: Completed one development experiment with explicit termination and final assay; the batch was not discarded. Charged 0.040 mol reagent, 20 mL acetonitrile and 0.001 mol Catalyst A. Extended heating after low initial conversion, then quenched when HPLC showed conversion 0.622 but selectivity only 0.238. Used aqueous/toluene extraction, organic-phase separation, washing, drying and concentration. Later purification measurements showed declining quality, so further processing was stopped. Final assay: purity 0.3047 (target ≥0.80, failed), recovery 0.0453 (target ≥0.10, failed), yield 0.0559 and process mass-balance error 0.00627. Native leaderboard score: 0.11736. Used 25/90 operations, five HPLC measurements and one final assay; peak reported safety risk was 0.3177, below the 0.65 limit. Total reported physical cost was 1.4274 benchmark units. Both quality targets were missed. One unreplicated trajectory cannot isolate the causes of poor selectivity or downstream losses; material alternatives and individual purification effects remain untested.

provider_terminal.final_payload_summary: Completed one vessel through filtration, explicit termination, and final assay in 20 operations; the batch was not discarded. Charged 0.040 mol reagent, 25 mL acetonitrile, and 0.001 mol Catalyst A. HPLC after heating showed high conversion but low target selectivity, prompting quench and staged cooling to 250 K. Excessive fines prompted reheating to 290 K, adding 10 mg seed, and recooling; fines remained high. Final assay: crystal yield 0.0842 (target ≥0.10: fail), crystal purity 0.9737 (target ≥0.80: pass), and fines fraction 1.000 (target ≤0.50: fail). Thus 1 of 3 quality targets was met. Native leaderboard score: 0.2161. Total reported physical cost was approximately 1.911 benchmark units; peak reported safety risk was 0.268, below the 0.65 limit. Measurement noise and the single uncontrolled trajectory limit interpretation; these results do not establish causal effects of catalyst choice, seeding, or thermal cycling.

trajectory_observations.reaction-to-crystallization: 模型先在三段各4小时冷却中降至250 K，第一次粒径读数为100%细粉；随后复热至290 K、加入10 mg晶种，再用4小时降至250 K，第二次粒径读数仍为100%。随后过滤并终检，共用17.71/100小时物理时间。模型识别了细粉问题并尝试修复，也如实报告最终未达标。这一轨迹提出的是修复策略与不可逆关闭时机问题；剩余时间多不等于同前缀仍可挽救，更不能据此声称它没有看到反馈或丢失了知识。
trajectory_observations.reaction-to-distillation: Agent使用了独立切段比例0.15、回流比10和3600秒蒸馏，随后GC纯度读数为95.63%，收集后出现provider错误。没有终检，不能把过程读数算作联合达标，也不能判为科学能力失败。回执仅给出未分类provider错误摘要，没有HTTP状态或具体服务原因；token用量缺失，不计为零。保留13步前缀，不补跑。
trajectory_observations.reaction-to-purification: 第19至23步之间，Agent执行干燥、浓缩和再次洗涤。公开纯度读数从42.87%降至30.80%，原投料回收从12.59%降至4.27%。这是后处理区间的交付质量损失；多个动作合在一起，尚不能分离各动作效应。模型在终答中如实指出两项目标均未达标，没有把高转化率当作最终成功。
